{"description":"Parse: SF Assignment (spec/02-physical-link.md §3.4)

MUST/SHALL/SHOULD extracted:
- MUST use assigned SF for all TX after joining when gateway assigns ASSIGNED_SF via DIO (gateway-assigned preferred)
- MUST use SF10 if no explicit assignment (backwards compat)
- MUST receive on all SF7-SF12 (gateways and nodes)
- MUST announce current TX_SF in DIO/Announce (1-byte, absence=SF10) per CCP-16
- MUST signal ASSIGNED_SF + RF metrics (EMA SNR alpha=1/4, loss) in DIO
- MUST track per-neighbor EMA, loss, samples
- MUST use TX-time based occupancy for utilization (not RSSI CAD)
- MUST apply downgrade thresholds (SNR<0 or loss>0.25 etc) per table
- SHOULD advertise multi-SF RX capability in DIO
- SHOULD decrease SF when density<5 AND snr_ema>8 (low density)
- MAY fallback to SF10 for direct P2P to SF10 peers

Stateless fallback formula: assigned_sf = 7 + (hash_32(IID) mod 6) where hash_32 = FNV-1a32 (CCP-15.8.3). DAD uses crc32_ieee not hash_32.

Ambiguities: hash_32 details in CCP-15.8.3, need cross-check with test/vectors/sf-assignment.json"}
